title: A quiet moment of Dex
content: Dex is a good friend of ours who's been dropping by most weeks lately. One evening before the heat set in, I caught this shot of him — ended up being one of his favorites too.
contentZh: Dex是我们的老朋友，近来几乎每周都会来。入夏前的某个夜晚，我随手按下快门，没想到定格了他最松弛的样子——他自己看了，也说喜欢。

title: Sunny Saucy, Fifty Shades Of Grey
content: This Friday night, come and have a drink or much more, with Matthew, our latest one-night host.
contentZh: 本周五晚上，我们将迎来一日店长马修，来和他一醉方休吧！
